record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: Brouwer-type fixed point property for VMO maps
record.original_question: Let B be the closed unit ball in R^N, and let f be a VMO map from B into itself. Is it true that for every epsilon > 0, the approximate fixed-point set {x in B : |f(x)-x| < epsilon} has positive measure?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5.10. Let B be the closed unit ball in R^N and let f be a VMO map from B into itself. Is it true that for every epsilon > 0, the set {x in B: |f(x)-x| < epsilon} has positive measure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N\ge 1$ and let $B$ denote the closed unit ball in $\mathbb{R}^N$. Recall that a measurable map $f:B\to\mathbb{R}^N$ belongs to $\mathrm{BMO}(B)$ if 
$$\|f\|_{\mathrm{BMO}}:=\sup_{Q\subset B}\frac{1}{|Q|}\int_Q |f(x)-f_Q|\,dx<\infty,$$
where the supremum is taken over all cubes (or balls) $Q\subset B$ and $f_Q$ denotes the average of $f$ over $Q$. The space $\mathrm{VMO}(B)$ of functions of vanishing mean oscillation consists of those $f\in\mathrm{BMO}(B)$ such that 
$$\lim_{r\to 0}\sup_{Q\subset B,\,\mathrm{diam}(Q)\le r}\frac{1}{|Q|}\int_Q |f(x)-f_Q|\,dx=0.$$

Suppose that $f:B\to B$ is a VMO map (i.e., a VMO map from $B$ into itself). Is it true that for every $\varepsilon>0$ the approximate fixed-point set
$$\{x\in B : |f(x)-x|<\varepsilon\}$$
has positive Lebesgue measure?
artifact.category_tag: VMO maps and fixed point theory
artifact.status_search_result: Brezis–Nirenberg established a Brouwer-type fixed point result for VMO self-maps of the disk, showing that $0$ belongs to the essential range of $\mathrm{id}-u$. However, the stronger quantitative question of whether the approximate fixed-point set $\{|f(x)-x|<\varepsilon\}$ has positive Lebesgue measure for every $\varepsilon>0$ does not appear to be resolved in the available literature, and no published solution was located.

status_evidence.title: Degree theory and BMO, Part I
status_evidence.snippet: Degree theory is extended to VMO maps; a Brouwer-type fixed-point result is established for VMO self-maps of the disk.
status_evidence.claim: Background: Brezis–Nirenberg developed degree theory and a fixed-point result for VMO maps, the context of this open problem.

status_evidence.title: Degree Theory for VMO Maps on Metric Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: VMO degree theory is defined via approximation; essential range arguments give a Brouwer-type fixed point result.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms only qualitative essential-range fixed-point results; positive measure of approximate fixed-point set not addressed.
